data.config.toml:
[info]
url = "http://mint:3338"
listen_host = "0.0.0.0"
listen_port = 3338
mnemonic = "file:/mint-secrets/mint-mnemonic"
enable_info_page = false
input_fee_ppk = 100
use_keyset_v2 = true

[info.quote_ttl]
mint_ttl = 600
melt_ttl = 120

[info.http_cache]
backend = "memory"
ttl = 60
tti = 60

[mint_info]
name = "Proofstorm CDK mint"
description = "Proofstorm regtest CDK mint"

[limits]
max_inputs = 1000
max_outputs = 1000

[mint_management_rpc]
enabled = true
address = "127.0.0.1"
port = 8086
tls_dir = "/management-server/tls"
allow_insecure = false
allow_mint_quote_payment_override = false

[payment_backend]
backend = "lnd"
unit = "sat"
min_mint = 1
max_mint = 500000
min_melt = 1
max_melt = 500000

[lnd]
address = "https://lightning:10009"
cert_file = "/lnd/tls.cert"
macaroon_file = "/lnd/data/chain/bitcoin/regtest/admin.macaroon"

[database]
engine = "postgres"

[database.postgres]
url = "env:CDK_MINTD_POSTGRES_URL"
tls_mode = "disable"
max_connections = 20
connection_timeout_seconds = 10

command:
set -eu
cdk-mintd config validate --file /config/config.toml
work_dir=${CDK_MINTD_WORK_DIR:-/app/data}
marker="$work_dir/.proofstorm-config.sha256"
digest=$(sha256sum /config/config.toml | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if cdk-mintd config show >/dev/null; then
    # A process/pod restart must not undo management RPC mutations. Apply only
    # when the controller's authored document changes (or on first adoption).
    if [ ! -f "$marker" ] || [ "$(cat "$marker")" != "$digest" ]; then
        cdk-mintd config apply --file /config/config.toml
    fi
else
    # --new-mint refuses to overwrite an existing database after a failed read.
    cdk-mintd config init --new-mint --file /config/config.toml
fi
# Record only successful applications, atomically, on the persistent volume.
printf '%s\n' "$digest" > "$marker.tmp"
mv "$marker.tmp" "$marker"
initContainers.name: initialize-config
